figures.caption: Figure 1: Pipeline overview. (a) Simulation: parameters θ drawn from the prior drive the Jansen–Rit model, giving the observed EEG x. (b) Inference: seven z-scored summary statistics per channel form the 5× 7 array zi; in gated configurations (blue) a small MLP produces one weight αi per feature, tiled to all five channels, so the estimator receives zi αi in place of zi. Shades in (b): seed-averaged sigmoid importance of Table 1.

Table 1: Feature importance: gold-standard ablation vs. learned gate. Mean (SD) drop in R2 across 9 seeds when the feature is excluded and the pipeline retrained from scratch, with the exact sign-flip test’s p-value. † marks the test’s minimum attainable value, p = 0.0039, reached through unanimous agreement across all nine seeds. Gate columns give the per-feature importance |zi|αi of Section 2.2, pooled across channels. Rank 1 = most important by that method.
